title: Zaramo, Grecia, tutorial in italiano con Juancarlos Battilani

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor explains the steps verbally while standing in a circle with students before demonstrating. He guides the practice with spoken counts and transitions to music accompaniment.

lesson_structure.note: Teacher introduces Zaramo as a simple Greek dance based on the six model.
Teacher breaks down the step pattern and count sequence slowly.
Class dances along with music in a circle.
Teacher explains traditional roles and posture for men and women.
Full dance practice with music continuing through the end.

steps_taught.name: Zaramo step
steps_taught.description: Six-count step where left foot goes back and right foot goes forward.

what_works: Clear verbal explanation of counts before moving
Demonstration within a circle with students
what_hinders: Camera angle remains static from the front

evidence_segments.cannot_infer: exact foot placement details due to distance

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher demonstrates footwork counting aloud from one to six while stepping in place.
The group moves in a circle holding hands while performing the steps to music.

extraction.distinctive_method: Explaining the cultural context of traditional Greek men's and women's postures before practicing with music.
